notes.title: Get Blood Nova for 65% off during the Steam Spring Sale!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

notes.title: Blood Nova Celebrates Its One Year Anniversary - Now For 50% Off!
notes.content:
Hey all!

Blood Nova is a point and click space opera adventure. 

Princess Love is set to assume the throne of a powerful galactic empire. But when conspirators try to thwart her ascension, Love and her best friend Kel become stranded on an interstellar lighthouse. Prove Love worthy of rule in this thrilling point and click adventure game.

notes.title: Twilight Oracle is in the works - a new point and click adventure by Cosmic Void
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm working on Twilight Oracle, a fantasy comedy point and click adventure. 

You can wishlist it and check out the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2338490/Twilight_Oracle/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41461161/0113e8be42b260b07b6676f2d7f4beeeb0d4a612.png[/img]

Journey to a strange world in search of the fabled Oracle in this fantasy comedy point & click adventure. Play as Leo, a struggling student with the ability to breathe underwater, and explore a desert island and the depths of an alien ocean to uncover your school’s dark past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41461161/a4045e09574b2f092a3bafdcf009ee9698078c7b.png[/img]

Yours, 
Cosmic Void

notes.title: Blood Nova is now available on macOS!

Hey everyone,

We're super pleased to announce that the macOS version of [i]Blood Nova[/i] is available for download! Minimum requirements are Mac OS 10.14 or later. Thank you, Steven Don, for the port!

Best wishes,
The [i]Blood Nova[/i] team

notes.title: BLOOD NOVA is 30% during the Winter Sale!
notes.content:
BLOOD NOVA is ON SALE!

Hey folks!

As you're probably aware, the Steam Winter Sale is upon us! Accordingly, we've discounted Blood Nova by 30%. If you haven't checked it, grab it now! Although we aren't Deck verified (yet!) it plays perfectly well on the device.

Aviv and Ross

notes.title: Blood Nova is now 25% off during the Steam Autumn Sale!
notes.content:
Hey all, 

[i]Blood Nova[/i] - a new 2D space opera point and click adventure game - is now 25% off during the Autumn Sale! 

[i]The powerful and prosperous Velayan Empire has reigned peacefully for over three centuries, even as distant galaxies – connected to the empire by a string of star channels – have been wracked by war.

Now the empress is abdicating the throne. Her eldest daughter, Princess Love, must take her place. But when Love is targeted by conspirators seeking to thwart her ascension, she becomes trapped aboard an interstellar lighthouse, with only her best friend and protector, Kel Yakkavan, by her side.[/i]

Have fun!

notes.title: Blood Nova - Only Two Days Left for the Launch Sale!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

There are two days left for the launch sale of Blood Nova - a 2D fantasy / sci-fi point and click adventure game. Get your copy for 15% off now. 

If you're enjoying the game, please let us know about it, we'd love to hear from you. 

All the best, 
The Blood Nova team

notes.title: Blood Nova - a new 2D point and click adventure game - is now out!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I’m very happy to announce the release of Blood Nova, a 2D point and click adventure game played from a first person perspective.

Princess Love is set to assume the throne of a powerful galactic empire. But when conspirators try to thwart her ascension, Love and her best friend Kel become stranded on an interstellar lighthouse. Prove Love worthy of rule in this thrilling point and click adventure game.

Go play now! Have fun!

Yours,
The Blood Nova team

notes.title: Blood Nova will also be available on Linux on launch day!
notes.content:
Hey all,

This is a very quick announcement - Blood Nova will also be available on Linux! 

A MacOS version is still in the works. May take a few weeks more. 

That's it. :) 

The Blood Nova team

notes.title: Blood Nova is coming out on October 5th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Just a small reminder to say that we are only one week away from the release of our space fantasy point and click adventure, Blood Nova! After a year and change of intense development, it's hard to believe it - but we're almost there.

So, not that small of a reminder! We'll see you next week.

Best wishes,

The Blood Nova team

notes.title: BLOOD NOVA Release Date Announced: October 5th
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's official: Blood Nova will release on the 5th of October. That's just over a month away. We'll soon be coming out of the beta-testing phase, and we're pleased to say it's been quite a success. The game's coming together just as we'd hoped, and we can't wait to share Love's adventure with you all.

Best,
The Blood Nova team

notes.title: Blood Nova Beta News!
notes.content:
Hey all!

Just a quick update to say that Blood Nova is now code complete! We've started beta testing the game and hope to have a more substantial update in the coming weeks. It's been a long production cycle, and we can't wait for all of you to see what we've come up with. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41461161/e7dcee0d404585c1b61e6d54f34bf7ab841bb1d5.png[/img]

Best,
The Blood Nova team

notes.title: Blood Nova is part of Steam Next Fest - check out our demo!
notes.content:
Hey all,

Steam Next Fest has begun! There's hundreds of new demos to play and all kinds of other fun events taking place. It's a great time for us: we have just successfully concluded our Kickstarter campaign! Meaning development on Blood Nova is full steam ahead.

Our demo is available for you to play right now. Check it out and let us know what you think in the comments!

The Blood Nova Team

notes.title: Check out Blood Nova's Kickstarter for Cool Rewards!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, our new point and click adventure game Blood Nova is currently on Kickstarter! The first week has gone and the base goal has been met, but we'd love to meet our stretch goals! It would help us secure German text localization and, if we're real lucky, Mac and Linux ports.

We've got loads of cool rewards on offer, so feel free to check it out and back us! ♥️

Page on Kickstarter:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/shdon/blood-nova-a-pixel-art-point-and-click-space-adventure]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/shdon/blood-nova-a-pixel-art-point-and-click-space-adventure[/url]

One of the rewards grants you the magical ability to design a puzzle for the game!

Thank you for helping make this a reality,

Cosmic Void

notes.title: Blood Nova’s Kickstarter is officially LIVE, Starting today, 19.01.2022!
notes.content:
Hey all!

Blood Nova’s Kickstarter is officially LIVE, Starting today, 19.01.2022!

Click here to view the page on Kickstarter: 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/shdon/blood-nova-a-pixel-art-point-and-click-space-adventure

If you want to help us realize our vision, please do pledge us your support! There are a series of tiers with a wealth of rewards, including the chance to be credited as a producer, get your portrait in the game, and, at the highest tier, help create your own in-game puzzle.

Of course, if you can’t help support us financially, then please do help spread the word – re-tweet, like, tell your friends, family, cats and dogs. We’d be immensely grateful.

Best,
The Blood Nova team

notes.title: Blood Nova Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey all!

We are very proud to announce the release of our demo for Blood Nova! It comprises the first part of the game and is designed to give you a feel for its world and characters, as well as what to expect from its puzzles. It should take about an hour to beat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41461161/4e30d0ff00ceaaa92d41c7af270504ffbd06acf3.png[/img]

Please, let us know what you think on the discussion board, and help us spread the word! We'll be launching our Kickstarter on the 19th January; stay tuned for more updates! 

You can click here to be notified when the Kickstarter launches:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/shdon/blood-nova-a-pixel-art-point-and-click-space-adventure

In the meantime, we hope you enjoy our demo.

Best,

The Blood Nova team
